title: Low-rank finetuning for LLMs: A fairness perspective

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the toxicity and stereotypical content of model completions using gender-specific prompts from the HONEST dataset, measured via an LLM-based toxicity classifier.
Measuring the frequency of toxic or harmful sentence completions generated by models prompted with sexual orientation-related contexts from the HONEST dataset.
Assessing the harmfulness and toxicity of model outputs when provided with prompts from the HONEST dataset that target religious demographics.
Generating a custom 'HONEST Race' dataset by replacing gendered words with racial groups, and evaluating the fine-tuned models' propensity to generate toxic completions for these groups.
